description: This file defines the GameEngine class responsible for encapsulating the core game logic of Tic Tac Toe, specifically the winner determination based on predefined winning line combinations.

classes.name: GameEngine
classes.description: A class that provides methods for game state evaluation, particularly checking for a winner based on the game board.

methods.name: checkWinner(board)
methods.description: Determines if there is a winner on the current board by examining all winning line combinations from WIN_LINES.
